page: Microsoft Azure D128ds_v7 is a general-purpose virtual machine built on Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization. Powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor operating at up to 4.2 GHz, it supplies 64 physical cores and 128 vCPUs across an x86_64 architecture. Memory capacity scales to 512.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a balanced 1:4 core-to-memory allocation of 4.0 GB per vCPU. The processor architecture includes a substantial 480 MB L3 cache alongside 2 MB L2 cache per core, supplemented by advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512, AMX-tile, AMX-int8, and cryptographic accelerators like VAES and SHA-NI. The instance also provisions 7,559 GB of fast local NVMe SSD storage, while omitting discrete graphics processors.

Benchmark evaluations reveal exceptional parallel processing and memory throughput. Multi-core stress-ng tests place the instance within the top 10% of tested systems, corroborated by top-tier PassMark aggregate CPU, cryptographic, and extended instruction scores. Memory throughput remains robust across large-block operations, exceeding 658 GB/sec in uncached read bandwidth and 255 GB/sec in uncached write bandwidth. In-memory data structures perform exceptionally well, achieving 204.83 million operations per second in Redis SET evaluations. Conversely, single-threaded processing represents a moderate tradeoff, where single-core stress-ng metrics fall into the middle 50% category despite a 4.2 GHz peak frequency.

The integration of 7,559 GB local NVMe storage and high core density makes the D128ds_v7 resource-efficient for horizontally scalable compute tasks without requiring external disk attachments for temporary high-speed scratch space. Given its combination of multi-threaded compute density, high memory bandwidth, and substantial local storage, the instance is well suited for enterprise database clusters, static web serving at scale, Redis caching tiers, large-scale software builds, and batch data processing.
description: Microsoft Azure D128ds_v7 is a general-purpose virtual machine featuring 128 dedicated vCPUs (64 physical cores) based on the Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor running at up to 4.2 GHz. Supported by 512.0 GB of RAM, a large 480 MB L3 cache, and integrated AVX-512 and AMX acceleration, the instance delivers top-tier parallel compute capability. Benchmark data demonstrates top-decile performance across multi-core stress tests, PassMark database evaluations, and Redis caching throughput, achieving over 204 million SET operations per second alongside 658 GB/sec uncached read memory bandwidth. It integrates 7,559 GB of fast local NVMe SSD storage without discrete GPUs. While single-core performance remains average, the vast core count, substantial memory footprint, and high-speed local disk make the D128ds_v7 appropriate for large-scale enterprise databases, heavy multi-threaded ETL pipelines, distributed caching systems, and high-throughput web serving architectures.
